# Alpha-9: Pure Rust Biophysical Emergent Organism

> Repository: https://github.com/pro-aras/Alpha-9
> Language: Pure Rust (zero external ML frameworks, zero LLMs inside the organism core, zero English string lookup tables)

## Overview
Alpha-9 is an artificial life (ALife) cognitive organism written in pure Rust (`~19.15 MB` heap per organism, `<32 MB` hardware ceiling). Instead of top-down rules or static neural network weights, the entire body and mind are composed of living cells that metabolize prediction accuracy, split under high variance, hand off traits to neighbors before dying, and cluster in 3D space through co-activation bonds.

## Crate Architecture
- `crates/alpha-iface`: Sensory & motor frame interfaces (`SensoryFrame`, `MotorFrame`: retina RGB, 16 kHz PCM audio, physiological `body_flux`, `gaze_xy`, `action_drive`, `vocal_tract`, synthesized `pcm_out`).
- `crates/alpha-organism`:
  - `body.rs`: `HomeostaticBody` with Quadripartite Insular Cortex (Quabs & Parvizi 2026), 8 living `VisceralOrganCell` populations with Carandini-Heeger divisive receptor conductance, and coupled CellML v2.0 Neurovascular (`cbf_flow`), Astrocyte-Neuron Lactate Shuttle (`astrocyte_lactate_mm`), Mitochondrial `neuronal_atp_mm`, and Basal Forebrain `extracellular_adenosine_um` sleep-pressure ODEs.
  - `cognition.rs`: `DeliberativeMind` living `EpigeneticCell` ecology (`<= 448` cells) featuring dendritic ionotropic AMPA/NMDA + presynaptic vesicle RRP + Carandini-Heeger divisive conductance (`ionotropic_conductance`), Homoiconic Regulatory S-Expressions (`RegGeneExpr` code-as-data inside every cell), subform point-mutation mitosis (`patch_subform`), locked basal survival floor (`floor_locked`), and Stack-Aware Provisional Hold + Escrowed First-Traversal Self-Healing (`provisional_hold`, `escrow_gene`, `sealed_generation`).
  - `retina.rs`, `cochlea.rs`, `vocal.rs`, `heatmap.rs`, `curiosity.rs`, `binding.rs`, `genome.rs`, `plasticity.rs`: Log-polar foveated retina, gammatone/theta-trough cochlea, formant vocal tract, ATP-constrained biophysical cortical sheet, and learning-progress curiosity.
- `crates/alpha-world`: Open sensory arena, unscripted procedural physics, and acoustic synthesis.
- `crates/alpha-bridge`: C-ABI shared library (`libalpha9.so`) exposing `alpha9_bridge_init`, `alpha9_bridge_step_pair` (with bone-conducted vocal-cochlear reafference), and `alpha9_bridge_get_telemetry` for Python (`live/run_live_habitat.py`) and Steel Bank Common Lisp (`SBCL` `sb-alien` FFI).
- `crates/alpha-exams`: Automated 17-gate biophysical verification (`[G0]` zero strings in `alpha-organism`, `[HW]` `19.15 MB <= 32.0 MB` RAM ceiling, `[B1]`-`[B6]`, `[S0]`-`[S5]`, `[D1]`, `[L1]`).
